data.body:
Posted Gerrit `rerun-llm-review` on change 2479 patch set 2 because the current `LLM-Review -1` is `coverage-gap (review-error)` infrastructure fail-closed, not a code finding. This follows `docs/review-policy.md`: `recheck` is for Verified/CI only, while `rerun-llm-review` re-triggers LLM-Review. No new patchset was pushed and no force was used.

Investigation note for the AC greps: GitHub reports run `33545734894` as `event=workflow_dispatch`, `headBranch=main`, `headSha=1c8232b0ee4e943f021cb51b63d16656e7f4df0e`. That explains why the pre-merge Gerrit Verified run can still show trusted-main setup-uv logs even though the patchset changes all workflow/action files: the workflow definitions for this dispatch came from main. The post-merge main run is expected to be the first CI run whose workflow definitions include `.github/actions/setup-uv/action.yml`; I will use that merged-code run for the final non-vacuous AC greps unless Gerrit produces a patchset run that actually uses the patchset workflow definitions.
